reference: Dwight's real romantic relationships in the transcripts: Angela Martin (the main one: secret relationship from season 2, break-up in S4E3, on-and-off affair while she is engaged to Andy, then fiancee/wife at the end, S9E22-23), Isabel Poreba (a hotel hookup at Jim and Pam's wedding weekend, then dating/kissing in S6E19), and Esther (a farm girl he courts and dates in S9E17-20, though he does not end up proposing). Minor / short: Nellie (a kiss and a hotel key-card tryst as a negotiating ploy, S8E16) and Kelly (she kisses him once, S2E10).

evidence.line: Dwight: Girlfriend. Yes, ... she's not really the kind of person you'd think would be into Valentine's Day. Pam: Tightly wound? Dwight: (smirking) Exactly.
Dwight: [Kisses Angela, she slaps him and walks away smiling]
Jim: Dwight and Angela dating. Have been for six months. Pam: they have been dating for like two years.
Dwight: I stopped shaving because my girlfriend broke up with me.
Angela: Well, that was the last time, Dwight. I mean it. Dwight: Monkey. [kisses her] Angela: No, no. I have a fiance I very much like!
Dwight: You either break off your engagement with that singing buffoon, apologize, and then date me, or you can say good-bye to this.
Dwight: Need I remind you that we were together a month before the wedding? (Angela's baby Philip, Dwight believes he is the father)
Dwight: Be with me, Monkey. ... The eighty or ninety years that I have left in this life...I want to spend with you.
Dwight kneels with the ring; Angela: Okay, yes...yes, I will! [they kiss]
Minister: I now pronounce you man and wife.
Dwight [walking out of hotel room with a woman]: ... Isabel: So I'll see you at the wedding? Dwight: You know it. [they kiss]
Dwight: Isabel was nice, but I hope she doesn't think this is going anywhere.
Dwight: You are an impressive specimen. Isabel: Thank you. [Dwight and Isabel kiss]
Dwight: Esther, you look radiant as always. Esther: Thank you. [Dwight kisses her forehead]
Angela: Dwight is dating a brussel sprout farmer named Esther.
Esther: ...I knew I was seeing you tonight. [Esther kisses him]
Dwight: I was thinking of proposing to Esther today. ... Jim: So what is the problem? Dwight: Angela.
Nellie: give me a key card to your room. Meet me in seven minutes ... [Dwight and Nellie kiss]
Kelly: Hey. [Kelly leans up and kisses him] Dwight: You shouldn't do things like that. The man is supposed to do that.

list_items.item: Angela Martin (secret relationship, break-up, on/off affair, fiancee and wife by S9E22-23)
Isabel Poreba (hookup at the wedding weekend, then dating and kissing)
Esther (farm courtship, dating; he considers proposing but picks Angela)
Nellie Bertram (one kiss / planned tryst as a ploy in the hotel)
Kelly Kapoor (she kisses him once, he is startled)

caveats: Core = relationships presented as ongoing (several scenes or an explicit girlfriend/dating label): Angela, Isabel, Esther. Optional = one-scene kisses (Nellie, a negotiating ploy; Kelly, her initiative, Dwight not interested). Dwight's unnamed ex-girlfriends and the 'I have a girlfriend' claims of S2E21 are Angela or unverifiable; S3E20 'Karen' line is a parody. Offscreen/visual details (e.g. the Esther relationship's end, Jan, Pam) are not covered; Esther is dated only in S9E17-20 and never engaged (his 'Engaged... Check' in S9E22 sc.10 is a planned goal). Fan transcripts miss lines, so a fourth minor partner could exist; none found by searching dating/girlfriend/kiss/sleep terms near Dwight.
question: With whom does Dwight have a romantic relationship over the series?
